en: The image is a vintage postcard showing a scenic lake surrounded by hills and forests. In the foreground, a small peninsula or island with clustered buildings and a prominent church is visible. The lake stretches into the distance, bordered by green hills and a wide sky above. The text at the top of the postcard reads 'Maria Wörth (439 m) u. Wörthersee vom Pyramidenkogel.'
